text:
[RBND.6.1] **Two comparators, not many.** A runtime provides exactly
two binding comparisons, and each of its load paths that checks a binding
uses one of them ([RBND.6.3]):

- the **dialect-binding** comparison, over the tuple of [RBND.1.3],
  per the rules of [RBND.5.1];
- the **RT-config binding** comparison, over the tuple of [RBND.1.4],
  per [RBND.5.1b].

Both take an *expected* tuple and an *actual* tuple and yield either
agreement or one of the mismatch outcomes of [RBND.5.2]. Nothing else
about their shape is fixed here: the tuples are defined in [RBND.1],
the comparison in [RBND.5], and the spelling belongs to whatever
language the runtime is written in.
